scope: Three exact research summaries; linguistic fidelity only.

reviewed_texts.ID: Article 18 of Indonesia’s Law No. 8 of 2016 identifies rights of persons with disabilities to accessibility for using public facilities and to reasonable accommodation as a form of accessibility for individuals.
reviewed_texts.VN: Article 14(1) of Viet Nam’s Law No. 51/2010/QH12 prohibits stigmatization and discrimination against persons with disabilities.
reviewed_texts.TH: The Ministry of Labour-hosted English translation of Thailand’s disability empowerment law describes a prohibition of unfair disability discrimination in section 15, including certain unintended effects, with a qualified exception in its third paragraph. The translation has no legal authority; the Thai original must be checked.
